Aime la vie et profite
Jul 2025 • Friends
I am mainly addressing people who go to restaurants for a pleasant moment and not just "to eat". In this restaurant, the owner Ben, has managed to restore French-style dining through his cuisine and the quality of his staff. For those who are going to compare just the price with the price of Vietnamese restaurants "Go away" you are OUT!. When I enter this restaurant I feel an atmosphere that I came to buy with a very diverse, well-balanced menu. Courage to you Ben because you have a much more interesting Vietnamese clientele and that you will satisfy with your culinary knowledge. You are a beautiful encounter through your career

Superb Dining Experience in Vung Tau.
May 2024 • Couples
This was one of the best meals I’ve ever had and definitely the best we’ve had in Vietnam to date….and we’ve been here a month. The atmosphere was welcoming, service was excellent, great aircon…and the food was just divine. Such a varied menu that we had trouble choosing, but ended up sharing the foie gras, pork terrine, tuna tartar, mussels, asparagus, rib fillet and the most divine profiteroles I’ve ever tasted. With a pre-dinner drink each and wine, about AUD$139 all up - expensive for Vietnam but worth every cent. We couldn’t fault a thing.
